title: Contraindication
description: A negative therapy implication: a drug to avoid, de-escalate, or not initiate based on a finding in the report. Covers resistance mutations (e.g., EGFR T790M emerging on first-generation EGFR TKI), lack-of-benefit findings (e.g., RAS-mutated colorectal disqualifying anti-EGFR antibodies), and assay-derived exclusions (e.g., HER2-negative IHC blocking trastuzumab). Resistance evidence tiers from proprietary KBs go in evidence.externalLevels under the implementation's licensing terms.

drugClass.description: Pharmacologic class when the contraindication applies to a class rather than a single agent (e.g., 'anti-EGFR monoclonal antibody', 'first-generation EGFR TKI').

reason.description: Categorical reason for the negative implication.

narrative.description: Optional human-readable explanation for the contraindication. Should reference the specific variant or biomarker driving the call.

externalLevels.description: Optional map of proprietary or third-party evidence levels keyed by knowledge-base identifier (e.g., {"civic": "A"}). Use only with appropriate licensing for the referenced knowledge base. The open-source schema does not prescribe values for any particular KB.

evidence.description: Evidence-tier metadata. AMP/ASCO/CAP 2017 is the public taxonomy carried in the open contract. Proprietary resistance-evidence levels go in externalLevels keyed by knowledge-base name.
